notes:
July 2nd 2026
Version 12.1+ (stable) / 12.2+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Maximize your scene volumes on the FISA — right-click a scene (or several) and choose Normalize Volumes to raise everything proportionally so the loudest reaches full, banking headroom back onto the volume wheel while keeping your mix perfectly balanced. (K)
* Set Editor for .FR8 / .FR4 files — open a saved Set file and edit its registers right on your computer, no accordion needed. (R)
* Set editing in the Live Editor — read, edit, and write Sets directly on your USB-connected accordion. (R)
* See your active reeds at a glance — the Accordion, Bass & Chord, and F.Bass sections now show a live register diagram (the classic dot symbol) that updates as you turn reeds on and off. (R)
* Right-click any section to Enable, Disable, or Layer it — including layering right-hand sounds together (Accordion + Orchestra + Organ) to build combined registrations live. (R)
notes_beta:
July 8th 2026
Version 12.1+ (stable) / 12.2+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* K-Configurator now speaks your language — the whole app and the user manual are available in English, German, Dutch, French, Swedish, Italian, Portuguese, and Russian. The app picks up your computer's language on first launch, and you can change it anytime in Preferences. (K,R)
* A brand-new, plain-English K-Configurator user manual — a complete, illustrated guide right from the Help menu, in every supported language, as a web page or a PDF. (R)
* The Live Set Editor is now feature-complete in beta — read, edit, and write Sets live on your USB-connected accordion, plus Export or Import a single Set (.ST4 / .ST8), with faster, cleaner switching between Set and User Program modes. (R)
* Choose how long tips stay on screen — a new Preferences setting lets you set the pop-up help time in seconds, or keep it up until you move the mouse. (K,R)
* Fixed garbled text that could appear in printed and PDF program and scene lists. (K,R)
* Many accuracy and reliability fixes (K,R)
